notes: Governing documents: the PTO Policy Highlights (2018_00_link, Maternity/Parental Leave; 2018_02, Temporary Disability), file versions dated 2016-10-01, are Stevens' HR policy for all employees 'including faculty', stated in grant language ('will receive', 'shall receive'); read as governing HR policy in force on 2018-02-24, not as a summary of another saved document, so no summary_only flags. The Faculty Handbook (2018_01) is a 2015 web capture; its Leaves of Absence section (3.5) holds only 3.5.2 (leave without pay) and 3.5.3 (medical leaves); 3.5 intro, 3.5.1 Sabbatical body and 3.6 Promotions and Tenure show 'No data available'. Whether the 2015 text was in force on 2018-02-24 is not established: its components carry version_uncertain. The no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply: a faculty handbook and the HR leave policy covering faculty are saved.

Conflict: the handbook's medical leave with full base pay for up to four months (c11, c12) and the 2016 HR policy's full salary continuation for faculty up to 26 weeks during a temporary disability (c3, c4) describe the same paid disability absence with different lengths; flagged conflicting_sources and linked concurrent_with so neither adds to the other.

Cross-references not saved: the PTO Policy Highlights' sick leave provisions ('the sick leave and temporary disability provisions as described above'; only the temporary disability section is saved); the union contract for unionized employees; the Division of Human Resources website information on family leave insurance; Faculty Handbook Section 3.6 (Promotions and Tenure) and the 3.5 general text, empty in the capture ('No data available'); Appendix 1 (Imperatore School sabbatical) and Appendix 2 (reappointment), not relevant to parental leave.

Exclusion: 'The maternity/parental leave provisions described above do not apply to unionized employees.' The documents do not say whether any faculty are unionized; the provision names faculty among those covered, so faculty_group is the code.

Chain, birth parent: Maternity/Parental Leave 6 weeks full pay (c1) concurrent with the temporary disability leave 26 weeks (c3), paid by faculty full salary continuation (c4) and NJ TDI through the private plan (c5) within it (the handbook medical leave c11 with its pay c12 runs concurrently, and its discretionary extension c13 follows c11) -> NJFLA 12 weeks (c9, consecutive_after c3 by S1a) with NJ FLI 6 weeks (c10) concurrent with it; FMLA 12 workweeks (c8) alongside from the start.

Chain, non-birth parent: Maternity/Parental Leave 6 weeks full pay as primary caregiver (c1), or 2 weeks full pay within one year if not the primary caregiver (c2, in_lieu_of c1); FMLA 12 workweeks (c8) and NJFLA 12 weeks (c9) concurrent with it from the start; NJ FLI 6 weeks (c10) concurrent with NJFLA.

Staff provisions recorded for completeness: exempt staff salary continuation (c6) and non-exempt staff and unionized sick-day supplements (c7). Part-time faculty and part-time staff 'may be eligible for statutory temporary disability benefits' (noted on c5).
No calendar or term length stated; no leave limit or all-sources paid cap stated.
